description: This file contains unit tests for the EmploymentStatusService class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods related to employment status management such as delete, get by ID, save, search, and count.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the EmploymentStatusService's functionalities related to employment status operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating the service instance and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testDeleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests the deletion of employment statuses by verifying the delete method is called with correct IDs and the expected count is returned.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an employment status by its ID, asserting the returned object matches expected test data.

methods.name: testSaveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests saving a new employment status and expects the saved object to be returned.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests the search functionality for employment statuses, asserting the result count and object types.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of employment statuses based on search parameters.
